# Linden Park Office Relocation

**As of:** 9 October 2026  
**Overall status:** Green

## Status by dimension

| Dimension | Status | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Schedule | Green | No slips across 8 dated milestones. |
| Budget | Green | Forecast $652,000 vs plan $640,000 (+1.9%). |
| Scope | Green | All 1 scope change approved or rejected. |
| Risk | Green | 1 open item, none high-impact. |

## Executive summary

Linden Park Office Relocation is on track with overall green status across schedule, budget, and scope. The team has completed lease signing (10 June) and space design approval (24 July), with fit-out construction 72% complete and on schedule. Budget forecast is $652,000 against a $640,000 plan. Leadership approval is needed to confirm the staff move weekend (13 December) and approve after-hours building access for movers.

## Accomplishments this period

- Lease signed (completed 10 June)
- Space design approved (completed 24 July)
- Fit-out construction 72% complete, on schedule

## Next steps

- IT network and AV install starts Monday
- Furniture order and delivery continues (40% complete)
- Huddle rooms construction continues (10% complete)
- Confirm staff move weekend and approve after-hours building access for movers

## Top risks and issues

- **Furniture vendor lead time 6 weeks; order placed 18 September with 2-week buffer** (medium impact)  
  Owner: not stated · Mitigation: Order placed 18 September with 2-week buffer

## Decisions and asks for leadership

- Confirm the move weekend and approve after-hours building access for movers
